title: The debt-close retire test runs with the repo's installed packages
why: Coordinator 12:51 CST Nov 12 (its clock): the merge tool refused q_max #1163's debt close because the Retire test ran in a scratch worktree with no node_modules (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND typescript); CI run 43274529795 was green and 34 tests pass locally. Stands item 600.
note: Fix run_span in lint/check_debt_retire.py so the scratch worktree has the repo's dependencies, or reports a missing-dependency failure as unknown, never as a failed retire. Then batch runner 11 re-runs the q_max #1163 merge. Rule building-fix-cause-not-symptom; decision debt-close-runs-retire. Undo: owner b on item 600 (the q_max lane drops the debt close). Lane starting now (coordinator). Runner 11 13:27 CST Nov 12: q_max #1161 hits the same retire refusal as #1163; both wait on this lane. Owner page saves 15:26 and 15:28 CST Nov 12: item 600 none ("how are these the only two optoins"). Options c (each PR names its green CI run with a Retire-run line, the route decision debt-close-runs-retire gives; recommended) and d (merge now, close the debt in a follow-up) added at v2. This lane keeps going either way. Owner page save 15:46 CST Nov 12: item 600 c ("accepted pick"): Retire-run lines on q_max #1163 and #1161 naming each green CI run (decision debt-close-runs-retire); runner 11 merges again. This lane keeps going for later closes.
